description: The Coldwater Regional hangar: a prefab of corrugated steel, its floor a map of oil stains and tyre scuffs. Tool racks and a battered workbench line one wall; a wheeled ops desk with a bank of flight monitors faces the other. The roller door on the south wall stays down until something needs to roll through it. It smells of avgas, hot metal and cold coffee.

flags.intro_lore: Coldwater Regional keeps its runway going for the same stubborn reason the whole city does anything: because stopping is worse. The tool racks, the ops desk, the coffee nobody remembers brewing: all of it holds the shape of a working airfield long after the airline it served stopped existing. Somebody still tops off the avgas. Nobody's asked who pays for it.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
